statusDefinitions.verified-local: Bounded software or inventory criterion has local evidence; separate clinical, browser and release items remain open.
statusDefinitions.partial: A working foundation exists but the stated acceptance criterion is incomplete.
statusDefinitions.open: Useful work can proceed; completion is not proven.
statusDefinitions.needs-owner: Owner decision, clinical input, approved data or operational authority is required for this item only.
statusDefinitions.held: Source identity, condition, rights or spatial evidence prevents safe admission; prepare independent work without removing the hold.
statusDefinitions.proposed: Optional idea for assessment; not added to mandatory completion scope.
statusDefinitions.done: Exact acceptance evidence, scope, date and completion record are saved. Clinical approval must be separately recorded by the authorized human.

rules: Stable IDs survive reordering. Split an item into linked child IDs when necessary; do not silently delete scope.
Update status, exact source/revision, evidence and dated change log after each verified milestone.
Recheck stale evidence after a relevant source, renderer, case or contract change; never migrate approval automatically.
Report counts by status, owner and area; optional ideas are separate. Do not calculate an overall completion percentage from unequal items.
An owner-gated item does not stop independent engineering, teaching drafts or review preparation.
No patient data, private review notes, images, identifiers, credentials or uncleared derivatives belong in this checklist or GitHub.
Public deployment, billing, permissions, privacy clearance and clinical sign-off require their own authorization and evidence.
